title: Witch with Magic Staff
description: A female character with black hair and red fox-like ears floats dynamically in a dark forest, holding a glowing blue magical staff in her right hand and extending her left hand which emits sharp purple energy blades. Swirling purple and blue magical energy, glowing runes, red maple leaves, and dark smoke surround her against a misty background with dramatic light beams from above.
